body: can you give a hogan story too, or is that not finished yet?
Seeing as the difference is only a function call, what about making the regular one `clickedObjectIDsAfterSearch()`

ok, so we'd be using it in the following way.
```html
<button ${clickedObjectIDsAfterSearch()('Add to cart'))}>
   Add to basket
</button>
```
```handlebars
<button {{#analytics.clickedObjectIDsAfterSearch}}Add to cart{{/analytics.clickedObjectIDsAfterSearch}}>
   Add to basket
</button>
```
But I'm not sure it's ideal.
The other reason I don't want to encourage the use of hogan is that it's easy to make mistakes with it.
Example:
```handlebars
<button {{#analytics.clickedObjectIDsAfterSearch}}
      Add to cart
   {{/analytics.clickedObjectIDsAfterSearch}}>
   Add to basket
</button>
```
will pass `eventName = "\n       Add to cart\n    "`
To avoid issue with quotes or whatever we can encode/decode the value in `base64`.

We expose the `analytics` attribute on the `hit` why not follow the same convention than we have with the [`highlight`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/src/helpers/highlight.js) helper? It's an external function that takes the required parameters as input. We could use an external function that takes `eventName`, `results`, `hits` to create the payload and/or another function to create the attributes. Which means that we can re-use it to expose the [Hogan](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/0b60183393340a979478cc3f3aa78c10bc1c5b90/src/lib/createHelpers.js#L8-L23) version.
We should be careful about overriding hits' attributes. We might want to rename it something like `_analytics`?
I suggested this as well, but it should be `__analytics` (one for algolia, one for frontend)
yes let's make it private

If I understand your point well, this would require to [pass `results` to the Template component](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/2a416f8b6e5309b564d3f97824e9e447829fa2a7/src/components/Hits/Hits.js#L24-L34) inside data so that we can [use it in the helpers](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/70b3ecd1690f26482166ddc129adf541a06b52f7/src/lib/utils.js#L162-L166), which also means exposing the `results` in every hit. Is this what you had in mind?
Yes, I would say so.
